name: GridCraft
description: Spreadsheets you and your agent build together: GridCraft, with a CLI into its live window.
about: GridCraft, the open-source spreadsheet written in Rust, with a second pair of hands. You work in its window as you always would: formulas, tables, charts, PivotTables, conditional formatting, real .xlsx files. Your agent works on the same workbook through its own commands: it reads the sheets, runs any of GridCraft's commands on them, looks at the window as a picture, puts pictures in, and opens, saves and exports files. Its changes land on the same undo history as yours. It can never close a workbook you have not saved, or change the app's preferences. GridCraft is by ArtCraft (github.com/storytold/gridcraft), under the MIT or Apache-2.0 licence; this is Arfium's fork of it, whose control port also requires a key.

commands.name: doc

commands.name: window
commands.about: read the window's state, or take a picture of it - changes nothing

commands.name: command
commands.about: list GridCraft's commands and what each takes - changes nothing

commands.name: run
commands.about: run one of GridCraft's commands on the open workbook; never files or preferences

commands.name: file
commands.about: new, open, save, export, close, and insert pictures - the only group that touches your disk

commands.name: ui
commands.about: click, type and press keys in the window, as a person would
